description: This file defines the ExecutorchCallDelegate class and related functions for handling custom call delegation in PyTorch, including tracing, autograd, and proxy modes.

classes.name: ExecutorchCallDelegate
classes.description: A subclass of HigherOrderOperator that handles execution delegation for Torch custom operators.

methods.name: trace_call_delegate
methods.description: Handles tracing of call delegates with proxy unwrapping and module validation.

methods.name: call_delegate_cpu
methods.description: Executes the lowered module with arguments, converting immutable collections to mutable ones.

methods.name: call_delegate_autograd
methods.description: Handles autograd support for call delegation, creating gradients if required.

methods.name: call_delegate_proxy_torch_dispatch_mode
methods.description: Delegates calls within a ProxyTorchDispatchMode context.

methods.name: call_delegate_fake_tensor_mode
methods.description: Delegates calls within a FakeTensorMode context.

methods.name: call_delegate_functionalize
methods.description: Wraps and delegates calls in a functionalization context.

methods.name: is_lowered_module
methods.description: Checks if an object is a LoweredBackendModule without importing it to avoid circular dependencies.

methods.name: get_lowered_module_name
methods.description: Adds a lowered module to a root module and returns its assigned name.
